scope_note: Deployment wiring only. This lane changes no application runtime path: no apps/** or packages/** file is touched, so no running service behaves differently until an operator sets UNIT_TALK_COMMAND_CENTER_ENABLED=true and dispatches a deploy.

default_off_proof.method: docker compose config --services, with and without the profile
default_off_proof.profile_activation_site: promote job, inside the UNIT_TALK_COMMAND_CENTER_ENABLED guard

entrypoint_refusals.harness: executed against deploy/production/nextjs-entrypoint.sh with the exec line replaced

detail: remove the compose profile -> 'Command Center is off unless a deploy deliberately enables it'
publish on every interface -> 'reachable only from the deploy host'
copy the smart-form /login probe -> 'reachable only from the deploy host'
make a Command Center secret unconditional -> 'enabling cannot break a deploy that does not use it'
drop the entrypoint branch -> 'refuses to start on a configuration it cannot serve'
unguard the canary env write -> 'receives no credential it does not need' + canary/promote drift
let promote skip the profile -> 'Command Center is off unless a deploy deliberately enables it'

reserved_not_taken.non_secret_success_criterion: the promote job's 'Verify Next.js surfaces are healthy' step reports 'command-center: healthy', and curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4300/api/health on the deploy host returns {"ok":true,"service":"command-center"}

known_gap.reason_not_fixed: outside this lane's file_scope_lock, which is pinned at lane-start
known_gap.impact: .env.command-center is rewritten from secrets on every deploy and holds no code-versioned value, so a rollback leaves a working configuration for a surface that is default-off
